title: Allow console worker data-protection policy on /plexus/console log groups
description:
Follow-up to plx-50029c: ConsoleChatResponder can now apply data protection policy on /plexus/procedures/* but still fails on /plexus/console/* with AccessDenied for logs:PutDataProtectionPolicy.

Fix: extend IAM log-group resource scope for ConsoleChatResponder to include /plexus/console/* (and child streams) for existing CloudWatch Logs actions and policy application.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text:
Implemented IAM scope extension in `dashboard/amplify/functions/consoleRunWorker/resource.ts`:

- Kept existing CloudWatch Logs actions unchanged.
- Added `/plexus/console/*` and `/plexus/console/*:*` resource ARNs alongside existing `/plexus/procedures/*` scope.

Validation:
- `cd dashboard && npx tsc --noEmit -p amplify/tsconfig.json` passed.
